subject.title: fix(reef): add timeout and bounded JSON reads to relay transport

question: Should Reef relay REST operations adopt an unconditional 15-second request-header deadline after the unrelated daemon changes are removed?
rationale: Source and proof establish that an unbounded stall is a bug, but the repository does not establish 15 seconds as the Reef relay compatibility contract, and choosing that budget can affect slow existing relays.

options.title: Approve the 15-second deadline
options.body: Remove the daemon diff and retain the demonstrated 15-second fixed deadline as the Reef REST contract.

options.title: Choose another fixed budget
options.body: Remove the daemon diff and adjust the constant and proof to a Reef-owner-selected deadline, such as alignment with the 30-second WebSocket handshake budget.

recommendation.title: Approve the 15-second deadline
recommendation.body: Remove the daemon diff and retain the demonstrated 15-second fixed deadline as the Reef REST contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Pick-cat authored the merged current-main Reef relay request-bound implementation that this deadline directly extends.
